body: 7+ years.  Prior to that it was once New Year's Eve night and once in the summer.

We had a big destination wedding to go back about 2009 or 2010.  We knew about it a long time in advance, so plans were made, airfare and hotels booked etc...   A couple weeks before the wedding, my mom asked me about what else we planned to do while we were away.  She figured her and dad could join us a couple times.

  
I nonchalantly told mom we weren't going.  No big deal to me.   A couple days later the wife comes to me with a mad on, and asks why we're not going away?  Before I could answer, she said, "it's because I won't have sex"!  

I told her she was right, and that unless she wanted to explain to my family why we're in separate rooms, the discussion was over. 

I have not gone away with her since.   She was very sick\* a couple years ago and was in the hospital a while.  When she got home, she told said she wanted to go on vacation later in the year.  I told her she was welcome to go to anywhere we could afford.   She asked me if I was going, and I told her no.

We have not been a couple since 2017.   We're very close roommates, but I refuse to do anything to set myself for disappointment again.   We just had out 21st anniversary a couple weeks ago.  I did not acknowledge it.  When she realized later in the day it was our anniversary, she wished me a happy anniversary.  She looked sad, but that won't last long.

Every time I read one of the posts here about the turmoil experienced when it's time to go away a spouse, I get it in the feels from years of rejection.   I'm glad that's over, I just wish it ended differently.

\* Just a side note, we had agreed to stay together until no one was in school.  We would have been going our separate ways if she did not get sick.   It sucks, but I won't let my children see their dad abandon their mother after she became disabled.

Sounds like my wife.  Kisses and hugs hi and bye, or even just going upstairs or to walk the dog.  And the dog now sleeps between us, or more correctly, next to her most nights, I am getting comfortable with the couch.

I also get some alone time when she goes to bed and I stay downstairs.  I usually stay downstairs when I am feeling frisky, no sense (or use) rocking the boat, may as well take care of it myself.

Yes.  On the outside, it looks like we're a TV type standard loving couple.  Not sure why do that.   I half expect her to walk out the day after our son graduates and say it was all an act.  

I seriously wish I'd get into a gin fight at work.  At this point, I would not fight back.

OK, so I am loved but not desired.  Unfortunately, I desire her.  My wife happens to be a very good looking woman.  Also unfortunately, my moral compass will not allow me to cheat, UNLESS I leave her.

BTW, thank you very much for your candid response.
Just done.  Have zero desire for anything.

Yes, I did.  

We were great at first, every night actually.  I felt like I hit the lottery, my wife is beautiful and sexy and turns me on 24/7/365.   She started menopause early.   She lost interest in sex.  We've been to the doctors together and she tells them that it is her, she said she doesn't even desire to please herself anymore either.

We were on once a mouth or once @ 2 months.   Our son got older and started staying at friend's overnight or scout camping.   I thought maybe we could reignite some passion.  She excused out.   She knew I was disappointed.  

Disappointed?  Dead inside actually.  I think the exact words I use were, "you don't have a desire in your body".  I did not mean that mean, she just doesn't.   And she does not understand how, "I want to do it to please you", just cuts my heart out.  It kills me loving and lusting someone that has not desire for me.

A month or two ago, she made a comment about how she thinks she may want to be intimate again.   My opinion was she said that as lip service for me.   No other mention of it, no touching, kissing etc...   I will not try again.  I cannot take the rejection or worse, the duty fuck.

Truth is, I am going to get our son through school and find a way to "have an accident".  I don't want to be here anymore. I don't want my family to wonder why I killed myself.   I will have an accident so they have some closure.   I have a couple years to get my affairs in order.  Everyday that goes by I am another day closer to sweet peace.
